title: single-tick capacity availability archival evidence
policy: read-only: healer --mode check opens the SQLite store with mode=ro and gates every write behind --apply; this run did NOT pass --apply. No broadcast, no production write, no historical depth or business data backfill.

rootCause.defect: load_manager_closed_loop_rows omitted path_addresses_json from the SQL projection; catalog_from_rows keys the catalog by the ordered address path, so every row fell out of the identity and the published single-tick capacity never reached the execution path
rootCause.fixTitle: fix(capacity): 补回闭环目录的地址路径投影，修复单 tick 容量永不落地
rootCause.whyItLookedLikeCapacityLoss: the closed-loop catalogue is keyed by the ordered address path; the SELECT omitted path_addresses_json, so every published row fell out of the catalogue, the catalogue was permanently empty, and the published single-tick capacity never reached the execution path

positiveZeroAttribution.classification: real business conclusion: the chain is not profitable on these routes
positiveZeroAttribution.explicitlyNot: positive=0 is NOT recorded as a capacity defect, NOT as an identity defect and NOT as an unmeasured value: every one of the 44 reviews carries a confirmed best amount and a signed PnL
positiveZeroAttribution.evidence: every review reports runArbitrage returned ok=false with a signed PnL; the amount was measured and the measurement was not profitable

single_tick_capacity_unavailable.defect: SELECT omitted path_addresses_json -> closed-loop catalog keyed by ordered 3-address path was permanently empty

preview_pool_initialAmountRaw_required.defect: preview-pool path read config.initialAmountRaw as a REQUIRED field; the pure-consumer Python runtime never publishes a trading amount, so every route failed before probing

rpc_eth_call_failed.defect: previewBestPool eth_call transport failure (RPC endpoint unreachable / transport error)

secondaryCauseAttribution.note: the capacity-unavailable, initialAmountRaw and RPC eth_call missing values were all produced before the corresponding fix commit, so they are historical data and not current code defects

premiseFalsified.claim: the GOOGL sample loop_key with a zero Y segment is a degenerate route
premiseFalsified.correction: 0x000...000 is the canonical ETH native token on chain 4663; the 76 closed loops containing it are all active with capacity > 0
premiseFalsified.action: the check item was deleted outright, not rewritten as a negative assertion

capacityStatesOnLiveSamples.note: measured zero is never used to stand in for a missing value; the missing state is 0 and every live review carries a positive measured capacity
